reviews.text: My motorcycle center stand was bent and broken so he nicely welded everything back in place in under 20 minutes. Good experience overall
reviews.author: Bernardo B.

reviews.text: I called Tim frantic after a major piece of equipment broke off that I needed to run my business. Knowing I had no time to waste and pending orders in a few days I was definitely stressing. He was quick and extremely reasonable in price.
reviews.author: Kim Z.

reviews.text: If anyone needs a professional welder this is your man. On time goes above and beyond to make sure the customer is satisfied. Also his prices are great! He's worth the price. I personally want to thank you for taking the time to weld our wrestling ring.
reviews.author: Rob N.
